clips.title: The story
paras: Telf Joolam is a Darkspear jungle troll shaman watching over the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. He guides initiates of the Horde through the trials required to commune with and command the volatile element of fire.

Perched among the crags overlooking the borderlands, Telf Joolam tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Unlike the calm certainty of earth or the patient depth of water, the fiery spirits require sharp discipline and unwavering focus. Telf acts as a trialmaster, preparing young shamans to prove their worth to the wild embers before they are consumed by them.

Under Telf's direction, initiates brew and drink a ritual Fire Sapta to grant their mortal eyes sight into the unseen elemental planes. He directs supplicants up into the rocky summits to confront burning spirits directly, ensuring that every shaman who earns the flame carries respect for its ravenous hunger rather than reckless pride.
